item.statement: MDMA helps you tell what other people feel.
item.why: In lab tests, people felt warmer on MDMA but didn't read others better, and they named fear correctly less often. These were small studies using photos.

item.statement: On MDMA, people felt more for others in photos but got worse at spotting fear.
item.why: In one study, people felt a bit more for people in photos on MDMA but named fear, anger, disgust and surprise correctly less often. Another study also found fear harder to spot.
